BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL  ON THE 15 th OF APRIL, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 12585 of 2024  BETWEEN:-
 JAIL SINGH S/O SHRI GHANSHYAM, AGED ABOUT 21  YEARS, OCCUPATION: LABOUR R/O NARMADA NAGAR  DISTRICT KHANDWA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SAMAR SINGH RAJPUT - ADVOCATE)
 AND
1 . THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  POLICE STATION NARMADA NAGAR DISTRICT  KHANDWA (MADHYA PRADESH)

2 . VICTIM "A"
 THROUGH POLICE STATION NARMADA NAGAR  DISTRICT (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI ATMARAM BEN - DEPUTY GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE FOR THE  RESPONDENT NO.1/STATE) (NONE FOR THE RESPONDENT NO.2/VICTIM  DESPITE SERVICE OF NOTICE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the fifth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to F.I.R. No.261/2022 dated 03.08.2022 registered at Police Station Narmada Nagar, District Khandwa (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363,
366-A, 376, 376(2)(n), 376(3) of IPC and Sections 5(L)/6 & 5(i)(ii)/6of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: As per the prosecution story, on 03.08.2022, father of minor prosecutrix lodged FIR about missing of her dauther who had left the home on 02.08.2022 at around 02:00 pm at the pretext of going to shop.
When she did not return and could not be traced despite search, FIR was registered for commission of offence under Section 363 of IPC.
Almost after five months, she was recovered and that time, she was carrying pregnancy.
After investigation, charge-sheet was filed for commission of aforesaid offence.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that prosecutrix was a consenting party and she on her own had gone with the applicant.
At the time of incident, she was 17 years of age and was aware about all the things.
It is further submitted that applicant is in detention almost for a period of last one year & five months.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail, pending the trial.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
6. In this case, prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
She has supported the factum of kidnapping and rape/aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon her by the applicant.
DNA report is also positive.

Therefore, having taken into consideration the prosecutrix's evidence recorded before the trial Court, material available on record and other facts & circumstances of the case, but without commenting anything on the merit of the case, I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of bail to the applicant.
7. Consequently, this application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant - Jail Singh stands dismissed.
(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE @shish Jail Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21161608/
